title: Fake vendor adapter with scripted faults
description: A deterministic adapter used by every test: success, schema-invalid output, nonzero exit, runaway process, cost overrun, fabricated artifact claim and injection-laden output, plus a recorder that turns a real CLI transcript into a replayable fixture.
acceptance: Each of the seven scripted behaviours is selectable by a tag in the work order title
It runs with no network and no keys
The fabricated-claim script makes the artifact guard refuse the run (used by WS-P0-039)
